Starting the Feed & Discovery Audit of bainluck.com. I'll systematically evaluate the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience, capturing screenshots and documenting all findings.

I have completed the Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com. The site scored 52/100 on the health check. 

While the visual consistency, event detail pages, and specialized category hubs (Weather, Economics) are strong, there are several critical data quality and navigation issues that need attention:
1. A "FINAL" baseball game is showing a future date (June 17).
2. A squash player (Mostafa Asal) is listed as the 75% favorite to win The Open Championship in golf.
3. Placeholder data ("Team A", "Team B") is visible in live NCAA Baseball markets.
4. The main Discover feed lacks temporal organization (Live, Upcoming) and sport filters, making discovery difficult for casual fans.
